    bracket_amort_test.go:105: fix7 §4 1b pin (b): the amortized emission carries NO SeqReducer construction and no Init/Reduce/Combine sites; found reducer ceremony in:
        // generated by tcacomp — deterministic output; do not edit
        #include "tca/runtime.h"
        
        template <typename T>
        __device__ static __forceinline__ T BracketamortCombine0(T p0, T p1) {
          return (p0 + p1);
        }
        
        // Bracketamort: launch 100 CTAs x 32 threads (derived from the loop annotations: gridDim = max over LNTs of CTA LoC products, blockDim = (max warp-K product) x 32 — the runtime validates)
        namespace {
        
        __global__ void __launch_bounds__(32) Bracketamort(uint32_t R, uint32_t C, uint32_t e4, const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ z, float* __restrict__ out) {
          tca::rt::TensorView<const float, 3u> x_v(x, R, C, 4u);
          tca::rt::TensorView<const float, 3u> z_v(z, R, C, 4u);
          tca::rt::TensorView<float, 2u> out_v(out, R, C);
          tca::rt::Frag<float, 2u, 16u, 4u> tca_f0;
        
          tca::rt::KernelInfo kinfo;
          // LNT #0: R=CTA(T=32,LoC=100) C=sequential(T=64,LoC=1) e4=sequential(T=256,LoC=1) dim=thread/warp(LoC=32) dim=sequential(LoC=1) e4=sequential(T=256,LoC=1)
          {
            // CTA-space mapping (absolute LoC per dim: 100u — the factorization this nest remaps)
            tca::rt::GridMapping grid_map0(kinfo, 1u, 100u);
            // per-CTA thread-space mapping (absolute warp counts K per dim: )
            tca::rt::ThreadMapping thread_map1(kinfo, 0u);
            auto c0 = 64u;
            auto c1 = 128u;
            auto c2 = 4u;
            auto c3 = 0.0f;
            auto c4 = 0u;
            auto v0 = grid_map0.index(0u);
            auto c5 = 32u;
            auto v1 = (v0 * c5);
            auto c6 = 32u;
            auto c7 = 16u;
            auto c8 = 4u;
            // sequential reduction — the combiner is runtime-owned; per-element brackets [Init → reduced-dim walks (Reduce(value)) → Combine]
            tca::rt::SeqReducer<float> reducer0(c3, BracketamortCombine0);
            // @R tile-between rounds — CTA, T=32, LoC=100 (map dim 0)
            for (auto R_it0 = tca::rt::CtaIterator(grid_map0, 0u, 100u, 0u, 3200u, c0); R_it0.Has(); R_it0.Next()) {
              auto v2 = (v1 + R_it0.Index());
              auto v3 = tca::rt::umin(v2, c0);
              auto v4 = (c0 - v3);
              auto v5 = tca::rt::umin(c6, v4);
              // @C tile-between rounds — sequential, T=64, LoC=1
              for (auto C_it1 = tca::rt::SeqIterator(0u, 16u, c1); C_it1.Has(); C_it1.Next()) {
                auto v6 = tca::rt::umin(C_it1.Index(), c1);
                auto v7 = (c1 - v6);
                auto v8 = tca::rt::umin(c7, v7);
                // @R tile-between rounds — thread/warp, T=32, LoC=32
                for (auto R_it2 = tca::rt::ThrIterator(thread_map1, 0u, 32u, thread_map1.index(), 32u, v5); R_it2.Has(); R_it2.Next()) {
                  auto v9 = (v2 + R_it2.Index());
                  // @C inside walk (tile elements) — T=64
                  for (auto C_it3 = tca::rt::SeqIterator(0u, 1u, v8); C_it3.Has(); C_it3.Next()) {
                    // per-element bracket opens (argument-free; re-initializes from the construction-time init)
                    reducer0.Init();
                    // @e4 tile-between rounds — sequential, T=256, LoC=1
                    for (auto e4_it4 = tca::rt::SeqIterator(0u, 4u, c2); e4_it4.Has(); e4_it4.Next()) {
                      auto v10 = tca::rt::umin(e4_it4.Index(), c2);
                      auto v11 = (c2 - v10);
                      auto v12 = tca::rt::umin(c8, v11);
                      // per-thread tile fill of x (LoadTileThread) — no synchronization
                      tca::rt::LoadTileThread(thread_map1, tca_f0, tca::rt::TensorWindow(x_v, v9, C_it1.Index(), e4_it4.Index()));
                      // @e4 inside walk (tile elements) — T=256
                      for (auto e4_it5 = tca::rt::SeqIterator(0u, 1u, v12); e4_it5.Has(); e4_it5.Next()) {
                        auto v13 = (e4_it4.Index() + e4_it5.Index());
                        auto v14 = z_v.Get((v2 + R_it2.Index()), (C_it1.Index() + C_it3.Index()), v13);
                        auto v15 = tca_f0.Get(C_it3.Index(), e4_it5.Index());
                        auto v16 = (v15 + v14);
                        reducer0.Reduce(v16);
                      }
                    }
                    // per-element combine — every participant receives the element's final value
                    auto v17 = reducer0.Combine();
                    out_v.Set(v17, (v2 + R_it2.Index()), (C_it1.Index() + C_it3.Index()));
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        
        }  // namespace
        
        void BracketamortLaunch(uint32_t e4, const tca::Tensor<float, 3u>& x, const tca::Tensor<float, 3u>& z, tca::Tensor<float, 2u>& out, cudaStream_t tca_stream) {
          const uint32_t R = x.Dim(0u);
          const uint32_t C = x.Dim(1u);
          TCA_REQUIRE(z.Dim(0u) == R, "z.Dim(0) must equal R (dim R)");
          TCA_REQUIRE(z.Dim(1u) == C, "z.Dim(1) must equal C (dim C)");
          TCA_REQUIRE(out.Dim(0u) == R, "out.Dim(0) must equal R (dim R)");
          TCA_REQUIRE(out.Dim(1u) == C, "out.Dim(1) must equal C (dim C)");
          tca::rt::ValidateLaunch(dim3(100u, 1u, 1u), dim3(32u, 1u, 1u), 0u, 512u);
          Bracketamort<<<dim3(100u, 1u, 1u), dim3(32u, 1u, 1u), 0u, tca_stream>>>(R, C, e4, x.Data(), z.Data(), out.Data());
          TCA_CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        }
